svg.title: Gas Heaven (tiles v002) — collision layout
svg.desc: North is up. Coordinates in meters. Dark shapes block sight and movement; gray shapes block movement only. Windows and pallets occupy gaps. Grid spacing is eight meters.
svg.text: Gas Heaven (tiles v002) · 112 × 96 m · 1 tile = 8 m
9984 m² · 20 pallets · 17 windows · 11 generator candidates · 20 hooks · max hook walk 26 m
